title: The crystalline rocks of South Carolina
citation: Overstreet, W.C., and Bell, Henry, 1965, The crystalline rocks of South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Bulletin 1183, map scale 1:500,000.
notes:
USGS Bulletin 1183 (Overstreet and Bell, 1965), crystalline rocks of South Carolina, packet 1 (plates and pages 7-42): Carolina slate belt units. Plates (geologic belts, geologic map, metamorphic facies) are OCR noise and not itemized. Units are recorded from the 'Description of rock units' headings with their geologic belt and the first line of each description; details (mineralogy, localities, thickness where given) are not itemized. Belts and units are statewide; this bulletin covers South Carolina's crystalline rocks. SUBSURFACE: none.
Bulletin 1183 packet 2 (pages 43-76): Charlotte belt (heading missing from the text layer; group flagged inferred), Kings Mountain belt and Inner Piedmont belt units. Units are recorded from the 'Description of rock units' headings with their geologic belt and the first line of each description; details (mineralogy, localities, thickness where given) are not itemized. Belts and units are statewide; this bulletin covers South Carolina's crystalline rocks. SUBSURFACE: none.
Bulletin 1183 packet 3 (pages 77-109): Inner Piedmont (intrusive rocks), Brevard and Blue Ridge belt units, and Mesozoic and younger rocks; Brevard group taken from the belt description, Inner Piedmont groups from the belt heading in packet 2 (flagged inferred). Radiometric age tables and discussion (pages 94-109) not itemized here. Units are recorded from the 'Description of rock units' headings with their geologic belt and the first line of each description; details (mineralogy, localities, thickness where given) are not itemized. Belts and units are statewide; this bulletin covers South Carolina's crystalline rocks. SUBSURFACE: none.
Bulletin 1183 packet 4 (pages 110-138): ages of specific rock units; recorded where the authors adopt an age for a named South Carolina unit or pluton. North Carolina dated samples, metamorphic facies plate (page 138, OCR) and references not itemized. SUBSURFACE: none.
